Summary

(Not following the main storyline) (Funny/Oddball-oriented) (Star Iron Idea King) (Start as a genius)
Lin Yi transmigrated into the world of Collapse Iron and, for some reason, was invited by the learned and became a member of the Genius Club.
A pseudo-genius who is all talk and no action can only drift through life and try to improve himself.
"Imprison a large amount of abundant abominations within a miniature cavern, and launch it at near-light speed using a combination of warp and teleportation. Upon impact, send the coordinates to Lan along with the message 'Abundant abominations are here.' I call it the Earth-Exploding Celestial Star."
"Using the breeding colony as an inexhaustible source of wet power to generate electricity and provide computing power."
"Let it be preserved, absorbed, and multiplied, so that the Comet Wall may grow on its own."
"Compile a morally-based sword of Damocles to make the newly born, prosperous people honestly practice family planning."
Geniuses always manage to save the world from disaster; as for how those disasters came about, don't worry about that for now.
……
It wasn't until around chapter 100 that the series started to get into the more outrageous phase, with the group of genius troublemakers steadily expanding.
